I replied in #coastal-team, in the thread on your message.

The discount is 10%, not 12%. The 12% came from a Nov 17, 2025 note by Bettina in #coastal-team that she retracted in the same thread, saying she had misread June's draft worksheet. The signed amendment and the 2026 renewal order form both carry the 10% forward.

I told Kwame to confirm the figure with Bettina or June before it goes into the brief. That line said I "can't check the signed paperwork here," which was overstated: the brain has the signed documents. The 10% is supported by them, so the advice to confirm still holds, but the reason I gave was not accurate.
